headline: Packaging Operator
summary: Senior high graduate looking for work as a packaging operator. During work immersion at a longganisa and chicharon factory in Vigan I packed and sealed products, watched the conveyor and helped store finished goods. I work steadily and follow safety and hygiene rules.
skills: Storing finished goods in the warehouse

experience.title: Work Immersion Student
bullets: Packed and heat-sealed longganisa and chicharon packs on the packing table.
Watched the conveyor and told the line leader when packs came through unsealed.
Moved cartons to the finished goods store and helped count stock at the end of each day.

education.credential: Senior High School, TVL Track – Home Economics strand
